content.short: Noxx is a payroll and compliance tool for pseudonymous talents.
content.description: Legal entities currently cannot collaborate with pseudonymous individuals due to tax and legal reasons. Noxx uses zero-knowledge proofs to enable pseudonymous talents to work with legal entities in a compliant manner. This approach maintains privacy while satisfying applicable tax and legal obligations, offering a practical path for such engagements. By focusing on compliant interactions, Noxx addresses a gap where anonymity and formal business requirements must coexist.
